message.orig: Thanks again fer helpin' me with them plants!
message.transl: Dankschee nomml fir dei Hilf midde Gewäggse!

message.orig: It's been a pleasure takin' care o' them so far.
message.transl: Es isch so schee sich um dia zu kimmern.

message.orig: Thanks to some modern techno doodads Ah can keep 'em on display like that.
message.transl: Dank de moderne dechnische Gribesgrabes ko I dia äwwl im Äugle behalde.

message.orig: Welcome to mah cozy greenhouse y'all!
message.transl: Griaß die! Des isch mein gmiadliche Gewäggshäusle!

message.orig: Don't be shy now, darlin'. Here's where all yer hard workin' pays off.
message.transl: Nedd so vrdruggd, Mädle. All des harde Schaffe hodd sich ausjezahlt!

message.orig: Y'all did all the hard work, really.
message.transl: Desch isch bloß dank dir meeglich gewese!

message.orig: Ah was able to preserve all o' them precious flora y'all kept hittin'.
message.transl: I konnd dia all hie gschdäd konserviere und uffbaue.

message.orig: What Ah'm try'na say is: Thanks, Seeker.
message.transl: Was I dia eigendlich damidd saga will: Dankschee, Seeker!

message.orig: Y'all helped me fulfill mah dream and words can't say how much that means to me.
message.transl: Du hosch mir so sehr geholfe mei Draum zu erfülle, I ko dir gar nedd saga, wie viel mir des bedeuded.

message.orig: Well, guess it's time ta give that strawhat one last upgrade, dont'cher think?
message.transl: I kenna dir amol a Upgrade fir dei Hütle von letztamol verpasse, meinsch nedd au?

message.orig: Oh and take this too, will ya.
message.transl: Ond nimmsch des au no midd, ja?

message.orig: Y'all drop in whenever ya feel like!
message.transl: Ond komm amol vorbei, wenn de in de Gegend bisch!
